name: Provisions on Main Market & Deli
area_long: South Main Street in Midway, a mile from downtown and the stadium
tagline: Boar's Head deli sandwiches, charcuterie, daily specials, wine, beer, homemade treats and gifts from more than 30 local vendors. Grab & go, or grab & chill.
about: Anna Claire and Kenny raised six kids (two of them now work at "the POM") and live just over a mile from the market. They built Provisions on Main for the rhythm of real life: last-minute dinner scrambles, quick stops between activities, and the rare moments to slow down with friends and neighbors. Fresh, healthy food, local artisans, beer, wine, music and, most of all, community. "Come for what you need and stay for the connection."

ktown.title: What’s Cooking at Provisions on Main? Kenny Blake & Anna-Claire Blake
ktown.summary: We’re on scene in Kannapolis’ Midway neighborhood for EP 79! Ryan and David sit down with Kenny and Anna-Claire Blake at Provisions on Main Market & Deli to talk about sandwiches, local makers, and their hope to create a place where neighbors gather.
